model: YAMNet (real, Google-pretrained on AudioSet, unmodified) + PyTorch transfer head
note: No licensed distress-audio corpus (AudioSet/scream datasets all require registration or a Kaggle account) could be auto-downloaded, so the transfer head is trained on a SYNTHETIC proxy corpus (frequency-swept bursts vs noise), not real screams. The YAMNet embeddings underneath are the real Google model.
